## CLAIM claim:80440e2182e5653f-10a95ba642d5f530
欧拉公式：$e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0$。
Conditions: none
Validity: SUPPORTED

## CLAIM claim:33a33396a17d4175-52b77b6623878145
内积的第一个条件是 $\langle x, x \rangle \geq 0$，且 $\langle x, x \rangle = 0 \iff x = 0$。
Conditions: none
Validity: SUPPORTED

## CLAIM claim:33a33396a17d4175-a1256162969d9b33
$x \perp y \iff \langle x, y \rangle = 0$。
Conditions: none
Validity: SUPPORTED

## CLAIM claim:e7ea8bc17c2cc4ab-1179d617ab1927f1
级数是数列的累加：∑_{n=1}^∞ a_n = lim_{N→∞} ∑_{n=1}^N a_n。
Conditions: none
Validity: SUPPORTED

## CLAIM claim:e7ea8bc17c2cc4ab-299b0a9eebcfbe7c
Cauchy列定义为：∀ε>0, ∃N, ∀m,n>N: |a_m - a_n| < ε。
Conditions: none
Validity: SUPPORTED

## CLAIM claim:33a33396a17d4175-fb4f069d7b7a3635
内积 $\langle \cdot, \cdot \rangle: V \times V \to \mathbb{R}$（或 $\mathbb{C}$）满足三个条件。
Conditions: none
Validity: SUPPORTED

## CLAIM claim:33a33396a17d4175-f61bd8bdddda89dc
Cauchy 列的定义是：$\forall \epsilon > 0, \exists N, \forall m,n > N: \|x_m - x_n\| < \epsilon$。
Conditions: none
Validity: SUPPORTED

## CLAIM claim:33a33396a17d4175-bc34a5170ba42b6f
内积的第二个条件是 $\langle x, y \rangle = \overline{\langle y, x \rangle}$（共轭对称）。
Conditions: none
Validity: SUPPORTED
